property_summary: For any calldata of the clone form (selector + immutable args with a 2-byte length suffix), C.collateral() returns the 20 bytes at immutable-arg offset 0x14 (the collateral token), while the mutant returns the 20 bytes at offset 0x28 (the debt token), so whenever the two embedded addresses differ the mutant's return differs from the reference's.
change_summary: Change the immutable-arg offset from 0x14 to 0x28 so collateral() returns the debt token address instead of the collateral token address.
